column1: # kind-equivalence: one row per BindingErrorKind variant, in BindingErrorKind::ALL order.
#   rust_name = BindingErrorKind::variant_name(); member = BindingErrorKind::name() (what the bindings resolve)
#   c_code = #[repr(i32)] discriminant; c_emit = BindingErrorKind::c_projection() (the TST_E code C emits)
#   py / jvm = ';'-separated Enum.MEMBER lists (or '-'); *_parity = ok | pending
#   Python enums live in bindings/python/python/tstrans/exceptions.py; JVM enums in
#   PR 2 spells TODAY's members; WP-B2/B3 rewrite pending cells to <Enum>.<member> and flip parity.
#   ROW ORDER IS PART OF THE CONTRACT: the rail diffs these rows against the
#   print-kinds output line by line, so reordering a row fails the rail.
